title: Concrete Mixer 12-hour maintenance window blocks rentals
gherkin:
Feature: Maintenance blocking rule for Concrete Mixers
  Scenario: Concrete Mixer with 12-hour maintenance window becomes non-rentable
    Given a Concrete Mixer item exists in the rental system
    When an authorized user applies a 12-hour maintenance window to the Concrete Mixer
    Then the item should appear as non-rentable during the entire 12-hour maintenance period
    And rental requests for the item should be blocked during the maintenance window
    And the availability status should be updated immediately
rationale: Concrete Mixers are subject to a 12-hour (720 minute) maintenance window as an emergency override to the standard 2-hour rule. This test verifies the critical exception that the maintenance blocking rule must enforce for this equipment category.
usedContextItems: Concrete Mixers require a 12-hour (720 minute) maintenance window as an emergency override to the standard 2-hour (120 minute) rule|Maintenance windows must block rental activity and make items appear non-rentable during the maintenance period|Availability status must be updated immediately when maintenance periods are applied or changed

To: dev_leads@toolchain.com, pm_team@toolchain.com
Date: 2026-02-20 14:00
Subject: URGENT: Special Maintenance Rule for Concrete Mixers

Hi Team,

Regardless of what the current SRS (v1.2) says about the dynamic Maintenance Matrix, we have an emergency with Concrete Mixers. 120 minutes is absolutely not enough for proper cleaning/maintenance.

Effective immediately:
- Concrete Mixers MUST have a 12-hour (720 min) maintenance window.
- All other machinery can stay at the 2-hour (120 min) rule for now.

Please hardcode this for the Mixer category until the official Matrix is published in the next SRS version.

Best regards,
Tom (Operations Lead)
